title: Who am I?
description: My name is Brayan Javier Martínez Pinzón, a {age}-year-old self-taught developer from Colombia 🇨🇴.

title: Creative Side
description: I’m passionate about visual expression. Drawing has been a long-time companion, and it constantly influences how I approach UI/UX and front-end design with a creative lens.

title: Experience
description: I’ve been working in RPA development for over 3 years. While automation sharpened my logic and process design skills, I’m now fully focused on web development, where I aim to merge technical knowledge with strong design sensibility.

title: Languages & Interests
description: I enjoy languages and culture. I speak some English, Italian, Portuguese, and French, and I’m currently learning Korean 🇰🇷. K-dramas and K-pop are part of my daily routine, and they help me relax and stay inspired.
